This address offers a Calibre-Web catalog and a Quire account. Choose which to set up first. You can add the other in Settings.
You can add a Quire account in Settings to sync reading progress and access AI features.
Create your Quire account

Your reading progress, library and highlights move to the new account. This device signs in right away, and your other devices follow by themselves the next time they open Quire. Your Calibre-Web catalog stays connected.
New Quire password
Use at least 12 characters.
Create account and keep my data
Already have a Quire account? Sign in below.
That email already belongs to a Quire account. Choose another or sign in below.
Enter a valid email address.
This Calibre-Web login already has a Quire account. Sign in with its email and password, or scan a pairing code from a signed-in device.
Calibre-Web rejected the login saved on this device. Reconnect your catalog in Settings, then try again.
This server can’t create a Quire account from the app. Ask your server administrator.
Add another device
On the other device, open Quire, choose “Scan pairing code” and point it here. The code works once and expires after two minutes.
Couldn’t create a pairing code. Check your connection and try again.
Scan pairing code
On a device already signed in to Quire, open Settings → Quire account → Add another device, then point this camera at the code.
Quire needs the camera to read a pairing code. Allow it in system settings, or sign in with your email and password.
